status: rebuttal study of the certified step (Proposition 1, Equation 27); paired by seed, initialization and data order with sharp_training_v1 and target_aware_training_v1

pilot.scope: smoke test only; validation only; not reported as evidence

optimizer: plain SGD without momentum for every arm (the guarantee does not cover momentum); trunk moves along -G w for the arm weighting w; each private head along its own unweighted gradient, as in every earlier CelebA arm

step_rules.fixed: step 0.02 (the frozen Direct development-selected learning rate) at every update; realized change of every task loss on the same minibatch recorded
step_rules.certified: eligible only if every exact first-order response s_i = (K w)_i + |head-i gradient|^2 is positive; then the first step 0.02*2^-k, k=0..19, with L_i(after) <= L_i(before) - 0.5*eta*s_i for every task (Equation 27); otherwise hold the parameters

response_sources.stream: target-aware Stream transcript (strict descent, eps 0.05), Direct fallback
response_sources.mgda_ub: MGDA-UB weights from the representation Gram, then one native Gram action

primary_endpoint: final worst-attribute BCE over the 16,000-image training subset; paired direct_certified minus uniform_certified; three seeds; descriptive (per-seed values and mean)
secondary: number of updates at which the executed step raised at least one task loss on its minibatch, per arm
certified arms: updates accepted, held for no admissible step, held as not certified; accepted step sizes
primary endpoint for stream_certified and mgda_ub_certified against uniform_certified, and for each certified arm against its fixed-step counterpart
final worst-attribute and mean validation and test BCE and accuracy
first-order responses along each trajectory: trunk-only and with private heads
seconds per update and peak memory (recorded under GPU sharing with a concurrent Pythia-1B job; not compared across studies)
audits: at pre-update states 0, 150 and 299 of every reporting run, the responses that decide eligibility are recomputed from independent per-task autodiff (trunk responses and head terms, relative error 1e-4, and eligibility agreement); recorded, not halting
numerical_scope: FP32 model and losses, FP64 responses and comparisons; rounded same-minibatch checks, not interval enclosures; no population, momentum or exact-real claim
